headline: Logan Cooley completes hat trick with second left, Mammoth stun Penguins in OT
take:
ESPN reports that Logan Cooley, a Pittsburgh native, completed a hat trick against his hometown team with a second left in regulation, and Mikhail Sergachev scored at 3:27 of overtime to give the Mammoth a 4-3 win over the Penguins on Thursday.

The result fits what our numbers have shown about UTA so far this season. The Mammoth are 8-5-0 and carry 55.9% of expected goals (the quality of chances taken and allowed), and at five-on-five that climbs to 58%. Cooley has 4 goals against 3.35 expected from his own shots, so he is scoring about as often as his chances say he should, and he is taking 56.71% of five-on-five chances while on the ice. Sergachev is the bigger overperformer: 3 goals on 1.59 expected, and his 15 points in 13 games put him ahead of last season's pace of 59 over 78. We wouldn't bank on that goal total holding, but his 58.12% share at five-on-five and 23.38 minutes a night show a real role. UTA's goalies have saved 7.1 fewer goals than expected, so the win came despite the goaltending, not because of it.
